response.sql: WITH site_counts AS (SELECT zoneref AS site_code, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), shares AS (SELECT site_code, feature_count, feature_count * 1.0 / SUM(feature_count) OVER () AS share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share FROM site_counts) SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, share - average_share AS margin_above_average FROM shares WHERE share > average_share ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC, site_code LIMIT 10;
